items.title: When it comes to movies I've never seen whose titles I think about on something approaching a daily basis, for me, it doesn't get any better than DUNSTON CHECKS IN.
items.author: Dan Devine
items.body_excerpt: When it comes to movies I've never seen whose titles I think about on something approaching a daily basis, for me, it doesn't get any better than DUNSTON CHECKS IN.

images.alt: This is the poster to the film DUNSTON CHECKS IN. It features a orangutan with boxer shorts on surfing on a briefcase with his hands behind his head, looking extremely chill, in front of (but, because of forced perspective, roughly the same size as) the gleaming high-rise Majestic Hotel. The tagline, "He's about to turn a five-star hotel into a three-ring circus," is perfect. I have never seen this movie. I think about it all the time.

items.title: November 18, 2004: Jamal Crawford of the Knicks banks in the game-winning three at the buzzer in Houston.
items.author: NBA Cobwebs
items.body_excerpt:
November 18, 2004: Jamal Crawford of the Knicks banks in the game-winning three at the buzzer in Houston.

Crawford finished with 19 PTS/8 AST and Kurt Thomas had 23 PTS/14 REB to lead New York. Tracy McGrady had 24 PTS/8 AST and Yao Ming had 23 PTS/11 REB to lead the Rockets.

items.author: Hoop Informatics
items.body_excerpt:
CBB Top-5 Net Points Added

Glossary; Net Points measures how much a player helps or hurts their teams scoring margin. Credit or blame is divided up across every player involved in each play to estimate the players true impact on the score.

Learn more: espnanalytics.com/net-pts-expl...
